2225-4125-7507-8043.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
2225-4125-7507-8043.description:
Cast Kindred Charge for free due to Vision, choosing a creature type granted by Hivestone, creating a token copy of each creature you control with haste, and setting up a delayed exile trigger.
Put the copy of Vision whose ability has been used in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Shipwreck Dowser token enters, it triggers, returning Kindred Charge from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

969-2105-4598-8330.easyPrerequisites: Combat Celebrant hasn't been exerted this turn.
969-2105-4598-8330.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
969-2105-4598-8330.description:
Cast Massimo by paying its mana cost plus commander tax if applicable.
When Massimo enters, it triggers, exiling Essence Flux from your graveyard and giving Massimo the listed ability.
Declare Massimo and Combat Celebrant as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks.
Combat Celebrant triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage with Massimo. Its ability triggers, casting a copy of Essence Flux from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Essence Flux, blinking Combat Celebrant.
Repeat from step 3 each combat phase.

483-4279-6112--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
483-4279-6112--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Cruel Celebrant, Fumulus and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Cruel Celebrant trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Fumulus ability, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Cruel Celebrant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

2842-2946-4871-5670.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 2 or higher.
2842-2946-4871-5670.notablePrerequisites: A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
2842-2946-4871-5670.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Cult Conscript.
When Cult Conscript dies, Blood Artist and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Blood Artist trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1623-3312-8170.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand with the mana to cast it.
1623-3312-8170.description:
Cast the creature card in your hand by paying its mana cost.
Flickering Hound triggers, blinking Mystic Snake
When Mystic Snake enters, it triggers, exiling the creature spell cast in step 1 and causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost due to Guile.
Repeat from step 2.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-2466-3249-4054--52.description:
Activate Honor-Worn Shaku's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Honor-Worn Shaku's last ability by tapping Grimgrin, untapping Honor-Worn Shaku.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Honor-Worn Shaku's first ability by tapping it, adding an additional {C}.
Activate Honor-Worn Shaku's last ability by tapping Grimgrin, untapping Honor-Worn Shaku.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the creature castable for one mana from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature spell from your graveyard by paying it mana cost.
When you cast that creature or when it enters, Primeval Bounty triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature token, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

413-6972-7936.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature other than Dominion Saboteur that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
413-6972-7936.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Dominion Saboteur.
When Dominion Saboteur dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it. As it enters, choose to have it copy a creature you control that has a +1/+1 counter on it, so Dominion Saboteur will also enter with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Dominion Saboteur enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-4264-4890.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-4264-4890.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Altered Ego and Dack's Duplicate each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Altered Ego trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Dack's Duplicate trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-4264-4890.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

215-4188-4927.notablePrerequisites: You have gained at least 6 life this turn.
215-4188-4927.description:
Activate Accomplished Alchemist by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Accomplished Alchemist from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Accomplished Alchemist by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

112-4377-7757.manaNeeded: {4}{U}{U} the first turn with {3}{U} each extra turn
112-4377-7757.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that can attack and that cannot be blocked or killed by an opponent.
112-4377-7757.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Declare any creature as an attacker. When you do, Doom's Time Platform triggers, exiling Walk the Aeons from your graveyard with two time counters on it.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your upkeep, Walk the Aeons's suspend ability triggers, removing a time counter from it.
Cast Clockspinning with buyback by paying {3}{U}, removing a time counter from Walk the Aeons and returning Clockspinning to your hand.
Walk the Aeons's suspend ability triggers, causing you to cast it without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Walk the Aeons, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat from step 2 each turn.

546-4013-4613-7728.notablePrerequisites: There are at least five creature cards in your graveyard.
546-4013-4613-7728.description:
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Voracious Brood. Voracious Brood enters with at least five +1/+1 counters due to its replacement effect.
Activate Voracious Brood using Ramos's ability by removing five +1/+1 counters from it, adding {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2292-6972-7727.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Hulk.
When Hulk dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

3532-5078-6259-7719.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
The Astonishing Ant-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

647-4499-6723-7393.description:
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Niko.
When Niko enters, it triggers, creating two Shard tokens.
Activate Niko and the Shards by tapping them, adding {3}.
Repeat.

2034-4381--5.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Grumgully.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

5058-5686-7396.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the creature that has Screams from Within attached.
When the creature dies, Screams from Within triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to another creature you control.
Quintorius, History Chaser triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

943-3573-4235.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four artifacts.
943-3573-4235.description:
Activate Tolarian Academy by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}{U}.
Activate Deserted Temple's second ability by paying {1} and tapping it, targeting Tolarian Academy.
Rings of Brighthearth triggers, causing you to pay {2} to copy Deserted Temple's ability, targeting Deserted Temple.
Resolve both Deserted Temple abilities, untapping Deserted Temple and Tolarian Academy
Repeat
943-3573-4235.notes: With excess mana, you can instead untap another land instead of Tolarian Academy.

81-1394-2060-5231-7038.description:
Play Power Depot, which will enter with a +1/+1 counter on it due to its modular ability
Cast Toph either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {2}{R}{G} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Toph enters, it triggers, earthbending Power Depot and putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Power Depot equal to the mana spent to cast Toph, increased by Kami of Whispered Hopes.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Power Depot.
When Power Depot dies, its modular ability and Toph trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting the +1/+1 counters that were on Power Depot onto Crystalline Crawler, increased by Kami of Whispered Hopes.
Resolve the Toph trigger, returning Power Depot from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped. Power Depot will enter with a +1/+1 counter on it due to its modular ability
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Toph. Choose to return Toph from your graveyard to the command zone.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {R/G}.
Repeat step 9 until you have enough mana to cast Toph.
Repeat from step 2.

240-2921-5470-6633.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bartolomé del Presidio
Repeat from step 2.

2724-3080-5299-7334.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill The Neutrinos.
2724-3080-5299-7334.description:
Cast Exchange of Words by paying {1}{U}{U}.
When Exchange of Words enters, it triggers, exchanging the text boxes of itself and Wormfang Manta.
Declare The Neutrinos as an attacker, attacking a player who cannot kill it in combat.
When The Neutrinos attacks, it triggers, exiling and returning (tapped and attacking) Exchange of Words.
When Exchange of Words leaves the battlefield, its ability from Wormfang Manta's textbox triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
When Exchange of Words enters, it triggers, exchanging the text boxes of itself and Wormfang Manta.
Repeat from step 3 each turn.

1376-4038-5963.notablePrerequisites: There are at least two Elves on the battlefield.

3490-4289-5295-7075.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that has not been tapped this turn.
3490-4289-5295-7075.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, adding {1}.
The creature's ability granted to it by Tale of Katara and Toph triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

uses.n: The Legend of Kuruk // Avatar Kuruk

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Avatar Kuruk

804-2963-7009.manaNeeded: {20} minus {1} for each creature and artifact you control each turn
804-2963-7009.description:
Activate Sakashima the Impostor using Avatar Kuruk's ability by paying {20} minus {1} for each creature and/or artifact you can tap while activating it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Teleportation Circle triggers, blinking Sakashima the Impostor. Choose to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Avatar Kuruk.
Repeat each turn.

625-1978-3291.notablePrerequisites: Your devotion to green is at least three.
625-1978-3291.description:
Cause Karametra's Acolyte to become an artifact using Ashnod's Transmogrant.
Activate Karametra's Acolyte by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Karametra's Acolyte.
Repeat from step 2.

4659-5220-6650.easyPrerequisites:
The Lunar Whale has attacked this turn.
You control another nontoken artifact creature that can be cast using {C}{C} or less.
4659-5220-6650.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the nontoken creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Mortuary triggers, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast the creature by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

3259-6633-6642.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-6633-6642.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, SOLDIER Military Program triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.
3259-6633-6642.notes: If you control a commander, you can choose both of SOLDIER Military Program's modes.

2034-2811-3490-6283.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to gain life.
You have a nonland card on top of your library.
2034-2811-3490-6283.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to give Elas il-Kor indestructible.
2034-2811-3490-6283.description:
Gain life.
Amalia triggers, revealing the top card of your library and then putting a +1/+1 counter on Amalia, putting the card back on top of your library, and destroying all other creatures if Amalia's power is 20.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Elas il-Kor triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Amalia triggers. Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
When the Servo dies, Elas il-Kor triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Amalia trigger, revealing the top card of your library and then putting a +1/+1 counter on Amalia, putting the card back on top of your library, and destroying all other creatures if Amalia's power is 20.
Repeat from step 3.

2393-5173-5553-5626.notablePrerequisites: One of Greedy Freebooter or Shambling Ghast must be on the battlefield with the other in your graveyard.
2393-5173-5553-5626.description:
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying an amount of {E}, sacrificing Greedy Freebooter or Shambling Ghast and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand.
When Greedy Freebooter or Shambling Ghast dies, it and Sifter of Skulls trigger.
Resolve the Greedy Freebooter or Shambling Ghast trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Sifter of Skulls trigger, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Resolve the Chthonian Nightmare ability, returning either Greedy Freebooter or Shambling Ghast from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

1115-5696-5702.notablePrerequisites:
You have cast your commander from the command zone at least twice.
You have a way to cause a land to enter the battlefield under your control.
1115-5696-5702.description:
Cause a land to enter the battlefield under your control. Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Jyoti.
Put the token Jyoti into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The token Jyoti's enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Forest Dryad land creature token for each time you've cast your commander from the command zone this game.
When the Forest Dryads enter the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko triggers that many times.
Holding priority, activate two Forest Dryads by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token.
Repeat step 6 until there is only one Springheart Nantuko trigger remaining.
Resolve the final Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Jyoti.
Repeat from step 2.

3490-5231-5994.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
3490-5231-5994.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Securitron Squadron triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the Servo.
Animation Module triggers, holding priority, activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}.
Resolve the Animation Module trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat from step 3.

1494-1692-3021.notablePrerequisites:
Sage of Hours does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent.
Helm of the Host attached to Conclave Sledge-Captain.
1494-1692-3021.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Helm of the Host triggers, creating a token copy of Conclave Sledge-Captain with haste.
When the Conclave Sledge-Captain token enters the battlefield, its backup ability triggers three times, all targeting Sage of Hours.
Resolve all Conclave Sledge-Captain triggers, putting three +1/+1 counters on Sage of Hours, and causing it to gain the printed abilities three times until end of turn.
Deal combat damage with Sage of Hours, triggering its abilities granted by Conclave Sledge-Captain three times, putting three +1/+1 counters on Sage of Hours for each damage it dealt.
Activate Sage of Hours by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to take at least three extra turns after this one.
Repeat during your last extra turn.

2034-2060-2946-3602.notablePrerequisites: A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
2034-2060-2946-3602.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Cult Conscript, adding {C}{C}.
When Cult Conscript dies, Bhaal triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler and goading it.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {B}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Repeat.

1786-4691-4971.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
1786-4691-4971.description:
Draw a card.
Niv-Mizzet and Queza trigger.
Resolve the Queza trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and causing an opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Niv-Mizzet trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Vilis triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

1267-1434-3745.notablePrerequisites:
Identity Thief does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent is unable to block and kill Identity Thief.
1267-1434-3745.description:
Declare Identity Thief as an attacker.
Identity Thief triggers, exiling Medomai and causing Identity Thief to become a copy of Medomai until end of turn.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Identity Thief.
Identity Thief triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Identity Thief triggers, returning Medomai from exile to the battlefield.
During your cleanup step, Identity Thief stops being a copy of Medomai.
Repeat each turn.

1339-1636-3564.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three untapped Merfolk.
1339-1636-3564.description:
Activate Kumena's second ability by tapping three Merfolk you control, causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
The Insect enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

579-824-4474.notablePrerequisites:
Paradise Mantle attached to Leech Bonder.
Leech Bonder does not have summoning sickness.
579-824-4474.description:
Activate Leech Bonder by tapping it, adding {U}{U}.
Activate Leech Bonder by paying {U} and untapping it, moving a counter from target creature onto another creature.
Repeat.

417-3348.description:
At the beginning of your draw step, Island Sanctuary causes you to skip your card draw, and prevents creatures without flying and/or islandwalk from attacking you.
Because Gravity Sphere causes all creatures to lose flying, only creatures with islandwalk can attack you.

1157-1806-2034-2178-3441.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to cause Unlicensed Hearse to become a creature this turn.
Unlicensed Hearse does not have summoning sickness.
1157-1806-2034-2178-3441.description:
Cause Unlicensed Hearse to become a creature.
Activate Thornbite Staff's equip ability by paying {4}, attaching it to Unlicensed Hearse.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Eternal Scourge, adding {C}{C}.
Eternal Scourge dies, triggering Unlicensed Hearse, untapping Unlicensed Hearse.
Activate Unlicensed Hearse by tapping it, exiling Eternal Scourge from your graveyard.
Cast Eternal Scourge from exile by paying {1}.
Repeat from step 3.
